proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ X n m hn hi he
  have hn' : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_div, MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ hi, Finset.sum_congr rfl he]
  simp
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (m : ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, MeasureTheory.Integrable (X i) μ) → (∀ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = m) → ∫ ω, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, X i ω) / n ∂μ = m
